newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom hits all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom hits all-time high.

text.p: Shares of Portugal Telecom hit an all-time high of 5,825 escudos and dealers said they could soon test 6,000 in a mood of euphoria over telecommunications.
"The objective of 6,000 escudos is not a mirage, but a very clear aim that could be achieved this week," said a dealer who asked not to be identified.
Another operator said: "The interest is not exclusively in PT, but also affects Telefonica (de Argentina), STET and Telecom Italia ."
PT shares stood at 5,825 escudos, up 135, in volume of 311,442 shares.
